12.1.en: Arjuna: "Who's doing it better, those who love you in a personal form or those who meditate on the formless?"
12.1.hi: Arjun: "Kaun better hai, jo aapke saakar roop ko pyaar karte hain ya jo niraakar ka dhyaan karte hain?"

12.2.en: Krishna: "Those who focus on me with full faith and love, I consider the best."
12.2.hi: Krishna: "Jo poore bharose aur pyaar se mujh pe focus karte hain, unhe main best maanta hoon."

12.3.en: "Those who meditate on the formless, infinite and unchanging..."
12.3.hi: "Jo niraakar, anant aur kabhi na badalne wale ka dhyaan karte hain..."

12.4.en: "...with self-control, balance and care for everyone, also reach me."
12.4.hi: "...self-control, balance aur sabki parwaah ke saath, woh bhi mujh tak pahunchte hain."

12.5.en: But the formless path is much harder. It's tough for humans to connect with something abstract.
12.5.hi: Par niraakar ka raasta bahut mushkil hai. Insaan ke liye abstract cheez se judna tough hai.

12.6.en: Those who dedicate everything to me, make me their goal and meditate on me with love...
12.6.hi: Jo sab kuch mujhe arpan karte hain, mujhe goal banate hain aur pyaar se mera dhyaan karte hain...

12.7.en: ...I quickly pull them out of the ocean of struggle. I've got them.
12.7.hi: ...unhe main jaldi sansaar ke samundar se nikaal leta hoon. Main hoon unke saath.

12.8.en: Keep your mind and thoughts on me, and you'll live in me. No doubt.
12.8.hi: Mind aur soch mujh pe rakho, aur tum mujh mein rahoge. Koi shak nahi.

12.9.en: Can't focus on me constantly? Then practise. Bring your mind back, again and again.
12.9.hi: Lagataar focus nahi hota? Toh practice karo. Mind ko baar-baar wapas lao.

12.10.en: Can't practise regularly? Then just do your work for me. That alone gets you there.
12.10.hi: Regular practice nahi hoti? Toh bas mere liye kaam karo. Usi se pahunch jaoge.

12.11.en: Can't even do that? Then just let go of the results of what you do. Start there.
12.11.hi: Woh bhi nahi hota? Toh bas apne kaam ke result chhod do. Wahin se shuru karo.

12.12.en: Understanding beats mechanical practice, meditation beats understanding, and letting go of results brings instant peace.
12.12.hi: Samajh mechanical practice se better, dhyaan samajh se better, aur result chhodna turant shaanti deta hai.

12.13.en: No hate, always kind, no ego, calm through ups and downs, forgiving. That person is dear to me.
12.13.hi: Na nafrat, hamesha dayalu, na ego, ups-downs mein shaant, maaf karne wala. Aisa insaan mujhe pyaara hai.

12.14.en: Content, disciplined, determined, mind and heart given to me. That person is dear to me.
12.14.hi: Santusht, disciplined, determined, mind aur dil mujhe diya hua. Aisa insaan mujhe pyaara hai.

12.15.en: They don't disturb anyone, and no one disturbs them. Free from excitement, fear and stress. Dear to me.
12.15.hi: Na woh kisi ko pareshaan karte, na koi unhe. Excitement, darr aur stress se free. Mujhe pyaare.

12.16.en: No neediness, clean inside, skilled, unbothered, not chasing every new project. Dear to me.
12.16.hi: Na needy, andar se saaf, skilled, unbothered, har naye project ke peeche nahi bhaagte. Mujhe pyaare.

12.17.en: Not overly happy, hateful, sad or greedy. Beyond good and bad, full of love for me. Dear to me.
12.17.hi: Na zyada khush, na nafrat, na udaas, na laalach. Achhe-bure se pare, mere pyaar se bhare. Mujhe pyaare.

12.18.en: Same with friends and enemies, respect and insult, heat and cold, pleasure and pain. No attachments.
12.18.hi: Dost-dushman, izzat-beizzati, garmi-sardi, sukh-dukh, sabme same. Koi attachment nahi.

12.19.en: Praise or criticism, same reaction. Speaks less, content with whatever, steady and devoted. Dear to me.
12.19.hi: Taareef ho ya burai, same reaction. Kam bolta hai, jo mile usme khush, steady aur bhakt. Mujhe pyaara.

12.20.en: Those who live these values with faith and make me their goal are the dearest of all to me.
12.20.hi: Jo in values ko bharose se jeete hain aur mujhe goal banate hain, woh mujhe sabse zyada pyaare hain.
